title: Data & layout primitives
summary: Tables, lists, grids and blocks for showing real data cleanly, with tabular numbers everywhere.

components.name: Sortable data table
components.summary: Sticky header, sort chevrons with aria-sort, expandable detail rows and tabular numbers.
components.pattern: Table with sortable columns (APG Sortable Table)
called: rows and columns you can sort by clicking the header
table with arrows on column names

anatomy.name: Sorted column
anatomy.text: The arrow shows direction; numbers right-aligned.

anatomy.name: Sticky header
anatomy.text: Stays visible while the body scrolls.

anatomy.name: Row expander
anatomy.text: Opens a detail row below.

anatomy.name: Numeric cell
anatomy.text: Right-aligned, digits lined up.

components.prompt: Add a data table: real <table> with a caption, sticky <th> headers containing sort buttons, aria-sort on the sorted column, numbers right-aligned in tabular figures, expandable detail rows (aria-expanded), and a scrolling wrapper with role="region" tabindex="0" so the page never scrolls sideways.
components.debug: Debug my table. Rule out: divs instead of a table; aria-sort on the button instead of the th; the page scrolling sideways on mobile; numbers left-aligned in proportional figures; sticky headers hidden behind the app header. The symptom:

components.name: Virtualised list
components.summary: Renders only the visible rows of 10,000 so scrolling stays smooth.
called: list with ten thousand rows that stays fast
long list that only renders what you see

anatomy.name: Spacer
anatomy.text: Gives the scrollbar its true length.

anatomy.name: Window
anatomy.text: Only visible rows plus a few above and below.

anatomy.name: Row
anatomy.text: Tells screen readers where it sits in the whole list.

components.prompt: Add a virtualised list: a fixed-height scroll container, a spacer of count × rowHeight, and a window translated to the first visible row that renders only visible rows plus overscan. Keep keyboard navigation with aria-activedescendant and aria-posinset/aria-setsize.
components.debug: Debug my virtual list. Rule out: rows of variable height with a fixed rowHeight; re-rendering on every scroll event without rAF; focus lost when the focused row unmounts; the scrollbar length wrong. The symptom:

components.name: Bento grid
components.summary: Asymmetric feature tiles that collapse to one column on narrow containers.
called: apple style grid of feature boxes
feature grid with one big box

anatomy.name: Wide tile
anatomy.text: The headline feature.

anatomy.name: Tall tile
anatomy.text: A supporting story.

anatomy.name: Small tile
anatomy.text: One fact each.

components.prompt: Add a bento grid: a 3-column grid with one wide and one tall tile, each tile one idea (eyebrow, short heading, one line, a small visual), collapsing to one column when its container is under 620px.
components.debug: Debug my bento grid. Rule out: every tile the same size (that is a card grid); tiles with paragraphs; container queries on the grid itself (style its children); holes from spans on narrow screens. The symptom:

components.name: Scroll-stacking cards
components.summary: Sticky cards that pile on top of each other as you scroll, earlier ones receding.
called: cards that stack as you scroll

anatomy.name: Sticky card
anatomy.text: Each card sticks a little lower than the last.

anatomy.name: Front card
anatomy.text: Cards underneath shrink and dim slightly.

components.prompt: Add scroll-stacking cards: list items with position: sticky and increasing top offsets so they pile up, and buried cards scaled down by a few percent based on how many cards cover them. Plain stacking under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my card stack. Rule out: an ancestor with overflow: hidden breaking sticky; cards without solid backgrounds showing through; scale updates on every scroll without rAF. The symptom:

components.name: Comparison table
components.summary: Plan-by-feature matrix with a highlighted column and grouped rows.
called: plans side by side with ticks

anatomy.name: Featured column
anatomy.text: One column tinted, never more.

anatomy.name: Row group
anatomy.text: Groups like Usage and Security.

anatomy.name: Included mark
anatomy.text: A tick for sight, "Included" for screen readers.

components.prompt: Add a comparison table: a real <table> with plans as columns, grouped feature rows (scope="rowgroup"), one featured column tinted, ticks and dashes with visually hidden "Included"/"Not included", and a horizontal scroll container on mobile.
components.debug: Debug my comparison table. Rule out: ticks with no text alternative; the featured column tinted with low-contrast text; the page scrolling sideways on mobile. The symptom:

components.name: Timeline / changelog
components.summary: Dated entries on a quiet rail, the newest marked with the accent.
called: vertical line with dots and dates

anatomy.name: Latest entry
anatomy.text: The newest dot is filled with the accent.

anatomy.name: Date
anatomy.text: Machine-readable date, human label.

components.prompt: Add a timeline: an ordered list where each item has a <time datetime>, a title and a short line; a thin rail with dots; the newest entry marked with the accent and a "Latest" badge.
components.debug: Debug my timeline. Rule out: dates without datetime attributes; the rail misaligned with the dots at different text sizes; reverse order without saying so. The symptom:

components.name: Resizable split pane
components.summary: Two panes and a grip you can drag or move with the arrow keys.

anatomy.name: Grip
anatomy.text: Drag it, or focus it and use the arrow keys.

components.prompt: Add a resizable split pane: two panes with a role="separator" grip (aria-orientation, aria-valuenow/min/max), drag with pointer capture, arrows ±2% and Shift+arrows ±10%, Home/End to limits, double-click to reset.
components.debug: Debug my split pane. Rule out: dragging selecting text (pointer capture and user-select: none); no keyboard path; panes shrinking below usable sizes. The symptom:

components.name: Drag-to-reorder list
components.summary: Reorder rows by dragging a handle or with Space and the arrow keys.
components.pattern: List + live region (keyboard-accessible drag and drop)
called: drag handle with six dots to reorder

anatomy.name: Handle
anatomy.text: Drag it, or press Space, arrows, Space.

anatomy.name: Instructions
anatomy.text: How to move items without a mouse.

components.prompt: Add a reorderable list: a six-dot handle button per row; pointer drag with live reordering; a keyboard alternative (Space to pick up, arrows to move, Space to drop, Esc to cancel); every move announced in an assertive live region.
components.debug: Debug my sortable list. Rule out: no keyboard path; announcements missing; the whole row draggable so text cannot be selected; jank from layout reads during drag. The symptom:

components.name: Code block
components.summary: Monospace code with language tabs, a filename and a copy button.
called: code snippet with a copy button

anatomy.name: Language tabs
anatomy.text: Switch between languages or files.

anatomy.name: Copy
anatomy.text: Copies only the visible panel.

anatomy.name: Code
anatomy.text: Scrolls sideways on its own, never the page.

components.prompt: Add a code block: a <figure> with a caption bar holding language tabs, a filename and a copy button that copies the visible panel; the <pre> scrolls horizontally on its own and is focusable.
components.debug: Debug my code block. Rule out: the page scrolling sideways on long lines; copy grabbing the hidden tab; syntax colours under 4.5:1 in one of the modes. The symptom:

components.name: Stat strip
components.summary: A row of KPIs with tabular values and semantic delta arrows.
called: row of numbers at the top of a dashboard

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.text: Above the number, quiet.

anatomy.name: Value
anatomy.text: Large, tabular.

anatomy.name: Delta
anatomy.api: good or bad, not up or down
anatomy.text: Churn going up is red.

components.prompt: Add a stat strip: a <dl> of 3–5 metrics with labels above large tabular values, deltas coloured by whether the change is good (churn up is red), and hairline dividers; wraps to two per row on narrow containers.
components.debug: Debug my stat strip. Rule out: deltas coloured by direction instead of meaning; proportional digits; more than five metrics fighting for attention. The symptom:

components.name: Media card
components.summary: Image cards locked to an aspect ratio so a grid of them always lines up.
called: blog post card with an image

anatomy.name: Media
anatomy.text: Cropped to a fixed ratio so a grid lines up.

anatomy.name: Meta
anatomy.text: Read time and date, tabular.

components.prompt: Add media cards: the whole card is one link, the image cropped with aspect-ratio and object-fit: cover, a 1.03 zoom on hover inside its frame, an eyebrow, a balanced title and a meta line.
components.debug: Debug my media cards. Rule out: images of different ratios breaking the grid; the zoom escaping its frame (overflow: hidden on the media); nested links inside the card. The symptom:

components.name: Avatar stack
components.summary: Overlapping initials with a +n counter for collaborators.

anatomy.name: Avatar
anatomy.text: Overlaps the next by 8px with a ring in the page colour.

anatomy.name: Overflow
anatomy.text: "and 3 more".

components.prompt: Add an avatar stack: a list with an aria-label of the total, overlapping circles with a 2px ring in the page colour, initials as fallback, and a "+n" item for the rest.
components.debug: Debug my avatar stack. Rule out: no accessible count; rings in a fixed colour that clash in dark mode; images without alt. The symptom:

components.name: Description list
components.summary: Clean key–value rows for settings and record details.
called: details panel with labels on the left

anatomy.name: Term
anatomy.text: Muted, left.

anatomy.name: Value
anatomy.text: Primary text; inline action links allowed.

components.prompt: Add a description list: a <dl> of term/value rows with hairline dividers, terms muted on the left, values on the right, stacking on narrow containers.
components.debug: Debug my description list. Rule out: divs instead of dt/dd; long values overflowing (overflow-wrap: anywhere); terms wrapping into two lines at common widths. The symptom:

components.name: Global filter bar
components.summary: One filter bar per dashboard: date range, removable chips, add and reset.
called: one filter bar for the whole dashboard

anatomy.name: Date range
anatomy.text: The filter people change most.

anatomy.name: Filter chip
anatomy.text: Click to remove.

anatomy.name: Reset
anatomy.text: Back to the defaults.

components.prompt: Add one global filter bar for a dashboard: a date-range segmented control, removable filter chips, an "Add filter" button and Reset, emitting one state object every card reads. Never repeat filter bars inside cards.
components.debug: Debug my filter bar. Rule out: cards with their own filters disagreeing with the global ones; chip remove buttons without names; focus lost after removing a chip. The symptom:

components.name: Chat thread
components.summary: Message bubbles grouped by sender, with read status, an attachment and a typing indicator.

anatomy.name: Outgoing bubble
anatomy.text: Accent fill on the right; the tail corner is only on the last bubble of a group.

anatomy.name: Group header
anatomy.text: Name and time once per group, not per message.

anatomy.name: Typing indicator
anatomy.text: Three dots for sight, "Riya is typing" for screen readers.

anatomy.name: Read status
anatomy.text: Only under your latest message.

components.prompt: Build a chat thread: an <ol role="log" aria-live="polite">, consecutive messages from one sender grouped with one avatar, name and <time>, incoming bubbles on a neutral surface and outgoing on the accent, small tail corners only where bubbles stack, a file attachment card, "Read 09:45" under the latest outgoing group, and a three-dot typing indicator with hidden text.
components.debug: Debug my chat thread. Rule out: every message repeating the avatar and time; long URLs breaking the bubble (overflow-wrap: anywhere); the log announcing old messages on load; accent bubbles with text below 4.5:1. The symptom:

components.name: Prompt composer
components.summary: A chat input that grows with its text, sends with ⌘↵ and keeps attach and mode within reach.
preview: Summarise churn by plan for Q4
called: message box at the bottom of a chat
text box with a send arrow

anatomy.name: Text area
anatomy.text: Grows to eight lines, then scrolls.

anatomy.name: Send
anatomy.text: The only filled button, so it is easy to find.

anatomy.name: Shortcut hint
anatomy.text: Enter makes a new line; ⌘↵ sends.

anatomy.name: Mode switch
anatomy.text: Small and secondary.

components.prompt: Add a prompt composer: a rounded form with a textarea that grows to eight lines (field-sizing: content with a JS fallback), a bar with an attach button, a small Ask/Edit radiogroup, a "⌘↵ to send" hint, a character count that warns near the limit and a round send button that is disabled until there is text. Enter adds a line; ⌘/Ctrl+Enter sends.
components.debug: Debug my composer. Rule out: Enter sending when people expect a new line (or the reverse, document whichever you pick); the textarea jumping height on every keystroke; send enabled for whitespace; the page scrolling when the textarea grows. The symptom:

components.name: Kanban board
components.summary: Cards in status columns you can drag, or move with Space and the arrow keys.
components.pattern: Drag and drop with keyboard alternative
called: columns of cards you drag between

anatomy.name: Card
anatomy.text: One tab stop for the board; arrows move between cards.

anatomy.name: Column count
anatomy.text: Updates as cards move.

anatomy.name: Tag
anatomy.text: Colour plus a word, never colour alone.

components.prompt: Add a kanban board: columns as <section> with a heading and a live count, cards as list items that are draggable with native drag and drop, plus a keyboard path: Space lifts a card, arrows move it between columns and within a column, Space drops, Esc cancels; announce every move in an assertive live region.
components.debug: Debug my kanban board. Rule out: drag and drop with no keyboard alternative; every card as its own tab stop; counts that do not update; layout reads inside dragover causing jank; the board forcing the page to scroll sideways on mobile (scroll the board instead). The symptom:

components.name: Before/after slider
components.summary: Two images stacked with a draggable divider; arrows move it too.
called: slider that wipes between two pictures

anatomy.name: Handle
anatomy.text: Shows where to grab; the real control is the range input.

anatomy.name: Labels
anatomy.text: Each side says what it is.

components.prompt: Add a before/after slider: two images stacked in a 16:9 frame, the top one clipped with clip-path: inset(0 0 0 var(--pos)), a round handle on a 2px divider, and a transparent full-size <input type="range"> on top so drag, touch and arrow keys all work. Label both images and show focus on the handle.
components.debug: Debug my before/after slider. Rule out: a custom pointer handler with no keyboard path; images of different sizes drifting apart (object-fit: cover on both); the range thumb invisible but still the hit target; no aria-valuetext. The symptom:

components.name: Masonry grid
components.summary: Cards of different heights packed into columns with no gaps, in plain CSS.
called: cards of different heights with no gaps

anatomy.name: Tile
anatomy.text: Never split across columns.

anatomy.name: Media
anatomy.text: Heights vary; widths are equal.

components.prompt: Add a masonry grid with CSS columns: columns: 3 160px, column-gap 12px, each item break-inside: avoid with 12px bottom margin, tiles with media of varying height, a small tag and a title. Note that reading order runs down each column.
components.debug: Debug my masonry grid. Rule out: cards split across columns (break-inside: avoid); JS masonry libraries re-laying out on every image load; order that matters (columns read down, not across, so use grid when order is important). The symptom:

components.name: Swipe actions
components.summary: Swipe a row right to archive or left to delete; buttons do the same for mouse and keyboard.
called: swipe a row to delete like mail apps

anatomy.name: Row
anatomy.text: Vertical scrolling still works; sideways drags move the row.

anatomy.name: Buttons
anatomy.text: The same actions without swiping; hidden on touch-only devices.

anatomy.name: Confirmation
anatomy.text: Says what happened, so the change is not silent.

components.prompt: Add swipe actions to inbox rows: drag right to archive (green underlay) or left to delete (red underlay), commit past 30% of the row width, snap back otherwise, keep vertical scrolling (touch-action: pan-y), show Archive/Delete icon buttons on hover and focus for mouse and keyboard users, and announce each action in a status line.
components.debug: Debug my swipe rows. Rule out: no non-swipe way to act (buttons or a menu); swipes hijacking vertical scroll; deletes with no undo or confirmation; the row text staying selectable while dragging. The symptom:

components.name: Uptime bars
components.summary: A status-page strip with one small bar per day per service: green, amber or red.

anatomy.name: Current status
anatomy.text: The one sentence people came for, first.

anatomy.name: Outage day
anatomy.text: Red bar plus "Day 34: outage" for screen readers.

anatomy.name: Uptime
anatomy.text: Exact percentage over the window.

components.prompt: Add a status-page uptime strip: a header with the current state as a green pill, then one row per service with name and exact uptime, and 90 thin day bars coloured by status (operational, degraded, outage) each with visually hidden text, plus a legend and "90 days ago / Today" labels.
components.debug: Debug my uptime bars. Rule out: status by colour alone; 90 separate tab stops; bars too thin to see on mobile (drop to 30 days); a rounded "99.9%" that hides real outages. The symptom:

components.name: Review summary
components.summary: The average rating in large type, a row of stars and a five-to-one breakdown in bars.
called: average stars with bars for each rating
reviews summary like a store page

anatomy.name: Average
anatomy.text: One decimal place; the number first, stars second.

anatomy.name: Distribution row
anatomy.text: Share in words and bars.

anatomy.name: Count
anatomy.text: How many reviews the average is based on.

components.prompt: Add a review summary: the average (one decimal) in large display type, five stars with an aria-label, the total review count, and a distribution list of 5 to 1 star rows each with a bar and a percentage.
components.debug: Debug my review summary. Rule out: stars without a text alternative; bars without percentages; an average without the count; partial-star fills that ignore the actual value. The symptom:

components.name: File list
components.summary: Files with a type tile, name, size and owner, date and two quiet actions per row.
called: list of uploaded files with icons

anatomy.name: Type tile
anatomy.text: Three letters in mono; colour by family, never alone.

anatomy.name: Name
anatomy.text: Long names cut with an ellipsis, full name on open.

anatomy.name: Actions
anatomy.text: Each button names the file it acts on.

components.prompt: Add a file list: a header with count and total size, then rows with a 36×40 type tile (PDF red tint, sheets green tint, others neutral) showing three mono letters, the file name as a link with "size · owner" under it, the date, and Share/More icon buttons labelled with the file name.
components.debug: Debug my file list. Rule out: icon buttons without names; long names pushing the date off; file type shown by colour only; rows that are not links to anything. The symptom:

components.name: Diff view
components.summary: A unified code diff with old and new line numbers, +/− signs and softly tinted rows.
called: code changes with green and red lines

anatomy.name: Added line
anatomy.text: Green tint and a plus; the word for screen readers.

anatomy.name: Line numbers
anatomy.text: Old and new; copying code skips them.

anatomy.name: Summary
anatomy.text: +2 −1 at a glance.

components.prompt: Add a unified diff view: a caption bar with the file path in mono and a +N −N summary, then a table in a horizontally scrolling region with old and new line numbers (not selectable), a +/− sign column, the code, softly tinted added/removed rows and visually hidden "added"/"removed" text.
components.debug: Debug my diff view. Rule out: red/green as the only signal; line numbers copied with the code; long lines widening the page; full-saturation backgrounds that hide syntax colours. The symptom:

components.name: JSON viewer
components.summary: Collapsible JSON as a keyboard-navigable tree, with types told apart by colour and text.

anatomy.name: Toggle
anatomy.text: Click the row, or Right/Left.

anatomy.name: String
anatomy.text: Quoted, so type is clear without colour.

anatomy.name: Size
anatomy.text: {2} or [2] says what is inside when collapsed.

components.prompt: Add a JSON viewer: render an object as a role="tree" with nested groups, a caret that rotates on expanded nodes, {n}/[n] size hints, typed values (strings quoted in accent ink, numbers and booleans in amber, null in italic muted), one tab stop with arrow-key travel, Right/Left to expand and collapse, and a Collapse all button.
components.debug: Debug my JSON viewer. Rule out: building HTML from values without escaping (XSS); every node a tab stop; types shown by colour only; huge payloads rendered all at once (collapse past depth 2). The symptom:

components.name: Month calendar
components.summary: A month grid with colour-tagged events per day; arrows move by day and week, Enter shows the day.
called: calendar month with meetings in the boxes

anatomy.name: Today
anatomy.text: Filled circle; the only accent fill.

anatomy.name: Event
anatomy.text: Coloured edge plus the title; dots when narrow.

anatomy.name: Day summary
anatomy.text: Reads the selected day's events aloud.

components.prompt: Add a month calendar: a header with month and Previous/Today/Next, a 7-column table with weekday headers, out-of-month cells tinted, today as a filled accent circle with aria-current="date", events as small rows with a coloured left edge (dots under 560px), one tab stop with arrows by day/week, and a live line summarising the selected day.
components.debug: Debug my calendar. Rule out: every day a tab stop; events cut off with no way to see them; weeks starting on Sunday when users expect Monday (make it a setting); colour as the only event label. The symptom:

components.name: Order summary
components.summary: Line items, a promo code that recalculates VAT and total, and one clear action.
called: checkout box with subtotal and total

anatomy.name: Line item
anatomy.text: Name, what it is, price; machine-readable value.

anatomy.name: Promo code
anatomy.text: Optional and quiet; says clearly if a code fails.

anatomy.name: Total
anatomy.text: Biggest number, with the period it covers.

components.prompt: Add an order summary card: line items with a detail line and right-aligned tabular prices, a small promo-code form that explains failures and shows the discount as its own row, subtotal, VAT and a large total ("per month"), one full-width primary button and a reassurance line about when payment is taken.
components.debug: Debug my order summary. Rule out: totals that change width as they update (tabular-nums); VAT hidden until the last step; a promo field more prominent than the pay button; floating-point rounding in money (use integer pence). The symptom:

components.name: Product card
components.summary: Shop card with image, favourite, sale price, colour swatches that recolour the item and Add to basket.
called: product box in an online shop
item card with price and add to cart

anatomy.name: Favourite
anatomy.text: Names the product it saves.

anatomy.name: Price
anatomy.text: Sale price first; the old one struck through and announced as "was".

anatomy.name: Colours
anatomy.text: Swatches change the picture and say the colour name.

components.prompt: Add a product card: square image area with a "New" tag and a round favourite button (aria-pressed), the product name as a link, a one-line spec, price with a struck-through old price announced as "was £60", colour swatches as radios that recolour the image and show the colour name, and a full-width secondary "Add to basket" that confirms in place.
components.debug: Debug my product card. Rule out: the whole card and the button both being links; prices with no "was" for screen readers; swatches with no names; favourite icons with no accessible name. The symptom:

components.name: Comment thread
components.summary: Comments with one level of replies on a thin rail, +1 reactions and an inline reply box.

anatomy.name: Replies
anatomy.text: One level only, on a thin rail.
A count, not a heart; toggles.

anatomy.name: New comment
anatomy.text: At the end, where the conversation continues.

components.prompt: Add a comment thread: a heading with the count, comments with avatar, name, relative time and text, replies one level deep on a 2px left rail, +1 reaction toggles with counts, Reply opening an inline form under that comment, and a new-comment box at the bottom. Escape all user text.
components.debug: Debug my comments. Rule out: replies nested five levels deep; user text inserted as HTML (XSS); reactions with no count or pressed state; a Reply that opens a modal. The symptom:

components.name: Activity feed
components.summary: Recent events as one-line sentences on a thin rail, with an icon per kind and the time on the right.

anatomy.name: Event icon
anatomy.text: Kind of event; status events tinted.

anatomy.name: Sentence
anatomy.text: Who did what to which thing; nouns in bold.

anatomy.name: Time
anatomy.text: Relative, aligned right.

components.prompt: Add an activity feed: heading with "View all", then an ordered list on a thin vertical rail; each event has a 28px round icon (status events tinted green or amber), one sentence with the actor and object in bold, and a right-aligned relative time.
components.debug: Debug my activity feed. Rule out: every event a card; colour as the only status signal; absolute timestamps everywhere; sentences without the object ("Ana edited"). The symptom:

components.name: Delivery tracker
components.summary: The arrival promise as the heading, then order steps on one progress line with times.
called: where is my order progress bar

anatomy.name: Promise
anatomy.text: The answer first: when it arrives.

anatomy.name: Current step
anatomy.text: Ringed dot, filled line up to it.

anatomy.name: Expected time
anatomy.text: A window, not a vague "soon".

components.prompt: Add a delivery tracker: the heading states the arrival ("Arriving today") with the time window and order number below and a secondary "Track on map"; then four steps on one horizontal line (vertical when narrow) with filled green segments up to the current step, a ringed current dot (aria-current="step") and a time under each label.
components.debug: Debug my tracker. Rule out: the arrival time hidden under the steps; progress shown only in colour; no time window; the horizontal line overflowing on phones. The symptom:

components.name: Search results
components.summary: The query and count as the heading, kind filters, and rows with the matched words highlighted.
called: list of search results with highlighted words

anatomy.name: Query and count
anatomy.text: Echoes exactly what was searched.

anatomy.name: Match
anatomy.text: Highlights the words that matched.

anatomy.name: Next tries
anatomy.text: Suggests other words before the list ends.

components.prompt: Add a search results view: heading "3 results for “forecast”", pill tabs filtering by kind with counts, then a list where each whole row is a link with a kind label, title, meta line and a one-line snippet with matches in <mark>; end with suggested alternative queries.
components.debug: Debug my results. Rule out: the query not echoed; highlights by colour only without <mark>; several links per row; no suggestion when results are few. The symptom:

components.name: Usage meters
components.summary: One labelled bar per plan limit; turns amber at 90% and offers a way to add capacity.
called: usage bars on a billing page
how much of my plan is used

anatomy.name: Numbers
anatomy.text: "12 of 15": used first, limit second.

anatomy.name: Near limit
anatomy.text: Amber from 90%, never red until it stops working.

anatomy.name: Way out
anatomy.text: Says what to do, with a link.

components.prompt: Add a usage card: heading and reset date, then a two-column grid of meters (one per plan limit) each with label, "12 of 15" in tabular figures and a 6px bar with role="meter"; at 90% or more the bar turns amber and a note offers "Add capacity".
components.debug: Debug my usage meters. Rule out: progressbar role for levels (use meter); red for "almost full" (keep red for blocked); percentages without the real numbers; no reset date. The symptom:

components.name: Plan card
components.summary: Current plan and price, seats, next invoice and card on file, with one upgrade action.
called: current plan box on billing page

anatomy.name: Plan
anatomy.text: Name and period as a small pill.

anatomy.name: Next invoice
anatomy.text: Amount and date: no surprises.

anatomy.name: Upgrade
anatomy.text: The one action; invoices stay quiet.

components.prompt: Add a plan card for billing settings: eyebrow "Current plan", the plan name with a period pill and the price on the right, a hairline description list (seats used, next invoice amount and date, card on file with an Update link), and one primary upgrade action plus a ghost "View invoices".
components.debug: Debug my plan card. Rule out: hiding the next charge; a cancel button styled as the main action; dates without a year; card numbers beyond the last four. The symptom:

components.name: Team members
components.summary: Invite by email, change roles in place, remove people; the owner row is protected.

anatomy.name: Invite
anatomy.text: Right where the list is; validated on submit.

anatomy.name: Role
anatomy.text: Changes in place and says so.

anatomy.name: Invited
anatomy.text: Neutral pill until they join.

components.prompt: Add a team members table: header with seat count and an inline invite form, rows with avatar, name and email, a status pill (Active green, Invited neutral), a role select labelled per person (owner shown as fixed text), and a remove button; each change is announced in a status line.

components.name: Assistant conversation

components.prompt: Build an AI assistant conversation as an ordered list of turns: the user turn is a soft bubble aligned right; the assistant turn is plain prose on the left that renders paragraphs, ordered lists, a small table with right-aligned tabular numbers and a code block; under each finished answer put ghost Copy and Retry buttons and a quiet "From …" sources line. While an answer streams, set data-state="streaming", show a blinking caret at the end of the text and hide the actions. Errors appear under the question with "Try again". Announce "Answer copied" in a live region. No avatars, sparkles or gradients.
components.debug: Debug my assistant chat. Rule out: both sides in identical bubbles; answers as one wall of text with no lists or code blocks; actions visible while text is still streaming; the page jumping as tokens arrive (reserve space or stick to bottom); no live region for screen readers; an error that deletes the question. components.prompt: Build an API endpoint list from <details> rows. Each summary shows a fixed-width mono method tag (GET in the info tone, POST positive, PUT and PATCH warning, DELETE negative, always with the word), the path in mono on one line with {variables} wrapped in <var> and coloured with the accent text colour, a short "what it does" label that hides under 560px, and a chevron that rotates when open. The body holds a parameters table with a caption (name in mono with "required" written under it, type, description) and a sample response figure with the status code and a focusable <pre>. Keep rows 48px tall and closed by default except the first.
components.debug: Debug my API endpoint rows. anatomy.name: Window bar
anatomy.text: Neutral dots, a mono title and a replay button.

anatomy.text: Typed a character at a time after a muted $ prompt.

anatomy.name: Output
anatomy.text: Appears a line at a time. Tone marks success, warnings and errors.

components.prompt: Add a terminal window: a <figure> with a 36px bar (three neutral dots, centred mono title, replay button) and a mono screen. Lines are paragraphs: data-kind="cmd" gets a muted "$ " prompt and is typed at about 26ms a character with a block caret in the accent colour; data-kind="out" is indented, secondary ink, and appears 240ms after the line before it (data-tone="ok", "warn" or "error" colours it). All text is in the markup from the start and waiting lines keep their space, so the window never changes height. Play once when 40% visible; show everything at once under reduced motion. Use real commands and real output from the product, six to ten lines.
components.debug: Debug my terminal window. Rule out: the window growing as lines appear (layout shift); looping forever; text that only exists in script; invented commands or output; a black terminal forced onto a light page; no way to replay. The symptom:

components.prompt: Build an audio player bar: a 44px round accent play/pause button whose aria-label swaps with its icon, the title and a muted subtitle on one line each, a native <input type="range"> scrubber with a 4px track filled to the current position and aria-valuetext like "6:52 of 32:14", tabular elapsed / total time, a "−15" back button and a speed button that cycles 1×, 1.25×, 1.5×, 2×. Drive a real <audio> element when there is one. No autoplay, no waveform made of random bars, no volume slider (the device has one).

components.name: Invoice sheet

anatomy.name: Number and status
anatomy.text: The number in mono; the status in words, with a dot that agrees.

anatomy.name: Three facts
anatomy.text: Who it is for, when it was issued, when it is due.

anatomy.name: A line
anatomy.text: What it was, a detail under it, then quantity, rate and amount.

anatomy.name: The total
anatomy.text: The one large figure. Everything above it adds up to it.

components.prompt: Build an invoice as a document, not a card of widgets: a white sheet with a hairline edge and a small shadow, at most 560px wide. Top: who it is from on the left (name, then address in small muted text), the invoice number in mono and a status pill on the right; the status is words ("Due in 14 days", "Paid 4 Nov") with a coloured dot. Under a hairline: three facts in a row (billed to, issued, due). Then a real <table>: item with a small detail line under it, quantity, rate, amount; every figure right-aligned with tabular numerals and two decimals. A strong rule above the totals; subtotal and tax in secondary ink; the total larger and bold. A one-line note at the foot. Under 380px hide quantity and rate and keep item and amount. The lines must add up.
components.debug: Debug my invoice or receipt. Rule out: figures that do not add up; amounts left-aligned or in a proportional font; mixed decimals (£120 beside £1,800.00); a status shown by colour alone; a total no larger than the lines; a card full of badges where a plain table would do. The symptom:
components.note: Use it as the hero picture for anything that makes documents (invoicing, quotes, payroll, bookings): put it in hero-split's <div data-part="visual">. Keep the sums true: lines add up to the subtotal, tax follows, the total is their sum. Change data-state and the status words together.
